title: Your Products Can Travel from India to the UAE. Can Your Checkout Close the Sale too?
summary: Learn how Indian businesses can accept Tabby payments in India and offer payment plans to UAE customers through Razorpay Checkout.
body_markdown:
A customer in Dubai finds a handcrafted solid-wood dining set worth AED 2,100 on an Indian furniture brand’s website. She likes the design and is comfortable with the price. But at checkout, she hesitates. The entire amount needs to be paid upfront.


She leaves without placing the order.


For the business, the product wasn’t the problem. The customer had already shown purchase intent. The payment experience simply didn’t offer the flexibility she wanted.


Indian businesses looking to accept Tabby payments in India and offer payment plans to eligible UAE customers should pay attention to this kind of checkout friction. Through Razorpay Checkout, businesses can offer Tabby at checkout, making larger purchases easier to manage.


**Eligible Indian businesses on Razorpay Standard Checkout with International Payments enabled can activate Tabby from Dashboard → Account & Settings → International payments, subject to Razorpay’s and Tabby’s approval. Not available on Custom Checkout or server-to-server integrations.** Customers can select an available


**payment plan** at checkout, while businesses receive the captured payment through Razorpay settlements without collecting subsequent payments themselves.


##


Why should Indian businesses pay attention to the UAE and Saudi Arabian markets?


The GCC region has an established digital commerce ecosystem, with consumers increasingly comfortable discovering and purchasing products online. For businesses exploring how to accept Tabby payments in India while selling to customers in the UAE, understanding this market is an important part of building the right international checkout experience.


The opportunity is particularly evident in the UAE and Saudi Arabia.


- **UAE:** The e-commerce market reached AED 32.3 billion in 2024 and is projected to exceed AED 50.6 billion by 2029, according to EZDubai and Euromonitor International.


- **Saudi Arabia:** 88% of people in the country engage in online shopping, according to Ipsos’ Spotlight KSA study.


Sources:


[EZDubai’s UAE E-commerce Report](https://www.wam.ae/en/article/bjsbc4q-uae-e-commerce-market-reaches-aed323-billion-2024) and


[Ipsos’ Spotlight KSA study](https://www.ipsos.com/en-ae/spotlightksa-online-shopping-behaviour-attitudes) .


##


Tabby is live for UAE buyers today and coming soon for Saudi Arabia.


For Indian businesses across categories such as fashion, furniture, beauty, home decor and premium jewellery, these markets present an opportunity to reach customers beyond domestic boundaries.


However, entering an established e-commerce market also means competing on the overall shopping experience. Product quality and pricing may attract customers, but currency display, delivery information, payment preferences and post-purchase support influence whether they complete a purchase.


##


Why can paying the full amount upfront create checkout friction?


Customers may be interested in a product but hesitate when they have to pay its entire price in one transaction. Offering


**payment plans** gives eligible shoppers another way to manage higher-value purchases.


This can be particularly relevant for categories such as furniture, electronics, premium fashion and jewellery, where individual orders can represent a significant expense.


Consider the AED 2,100 dining set. A customer who would rather not pay the entire amount at once may be more comfortable splitting it into smaller payments. If eligible for Tabby Pay it in 4, the customer can split the order into 4 payments of AED 525 each, subject to Tabby’s approval and applicable terms.


Payment preferences matter in the UAE. Visa’s 2025 Global Digital Shopping Index found that 77% of UAE shoppers say the payment options offered by a retailer influence where they shop.


For Indian businesses, this makes payment choice an important part of the international buying experience. Businesses researching how to accept Tabby payments in India and sell to UAE customers should look beyond simply adding another payment method. Reaching a customer and attracting them to a product is only half the job. The checkout needs to give them a convenient way to complete the purchase.


[Source: Visa’s 2025 Global Digital Shopping Index, UAE](https://www.visa.com/en-ae/newsroom/uae-mobile-shopping-digital-retail-insights) .


##


How do Tabby payment plans work at Razorpay Checkout?


For Indian businesses looking to accept Tabby payments in India and make them available to UAE customers, Tabby appears as a payment option at Razorpay Checkout for eligible UAE customers. Tabby appears for customers checking out with a UAE mobile number or from the UAE, once Tabby’s eligibility check passes.


After selecting it, the customer completes the required verification, reviews the available payment plan and confirms the transaction.


Here’s how the journey works, using the AED 2,100 dining set as an example.


1. **The customer reaches checkout** **** After browsing the furniture brand’s website, the customer adds the dining set to the cart and proceeds to Razorpay Checkout. In this example, the order is priced in AED, so the customer can see the amount in the local currency.


2. **The customer selects Tabby** **** Tabby appears alongside other available payment methods. The customer selects it to explore the payment options available for the purchase.


3. **Tabby checks customer eligibility** **** The customer proceeds to Tabby’s secure payment experience. Depending on the information the business has already shared, the customer may need to complete OTP verification. Tabby then assesses the customer’s eligibility.


4. **The customer chooses a payment plan** **** If approved, the customer sees the payment plans available for the purchase. For example, if Pay it in 4 is offered, the AED 2,100 order can be split into 4 payments of AED 525 each, or the customer can pay over time for up to 12 months, as Tabby offers for that order, subject to Tabby’s approval and applicable terms.


5. **The payment is confirmed** **** The customer confirms the transaction. Razorpay automatically captures successful Tabby payments and sends the business a payment.captured webhook. The customer is redirected to the relevant success or failure page.


6. **The business fulfils the order** Once payment is confirmed, the business can proceed with order processing and fulfillment. The customer makes subsequent payments directly to Tabby according to the agreed schedule.


The distinction is important: the business does not need to collect each payment or track the customer’s repayment schedule.


##


What payment plans and currencies will customers see in Tabby?


Pay over time — 4 interest-free payments or up to 12 months.


4 payments: the order is split into four equal payments. The first is paid at checkout, and the rest follow on Tabby’s schedule.


Longer plans, up to 12 months: offered by Tabby for some customers and order values.


Tabby decides which plans each customer sees, based on its own checks. It also sets order value limits per customer and order. The business doesn’t choose the plan and doesn’t need to do anything different for each one.


Customers always see the amount in AED, converted at checkout:

AED


The same AED amount. No conversion.

INR


The price converted to AED at checkout, including a currency conversion fee shown before they pay.


INR

The price converted to AED at checkout, the same way.


INR


Pricing your UAE store in AED gives customers the clearest experience: the price on the product page is exactly what they pay.


##


What does offering Tabby mean for Indian businesses?


For businesses exploring how to accept Tabby payments in India, offering payment plans can make checkout easier for customers while helping businesses improve the buying experience.


1. **Reduce checkout hesitation** **** Give customers the flexibility to split larger purchases into smaller payment plans instead of paying the full amount upfront.


2. **Encourage higher-value purchases** Make premium products and larger baskets more accessible to customers who prefer spreading their payments.


1. **Simplify payment collection** **** Receive payment without having to collect individual payments or follow up with customers about repayments.


2. **Continue operating from India** **** Offer


payment plans to eligible UAE customers while continuing to run the business and receive payments in India.


3. **Refunds from the Razorpay Dashboard** **** Full and partial refunds are supported from the Razorpay Dashboard within 180 days of the payment.


##


What should businesses consider beyond offering payment plans?


Knowing how to accept Tabby payments in India is only one part of preparing for UAE customers. A flexible payment option can help a customer complete a purchase, but the rest of the buying experience still matters. Indian businesses selling to the UAE should make sure customers know what to expect before and after payment.


A few essentials include:


- Local pricing: Display prices in AED and communicate the final payable amount clearly.


- Delivery information: Explain shipping charges, estimated delivery timelines and any applicable customs duties.


- Product details: Provide clear images, dimensions, materials and specifications, particularly for higher-value products such as furniture.


- Returns and refunds: Make international return policies and refund timelines easy to find.


- Customer support: Give international customers a clear way to raise questions about orders, delivery and payments.


The aim is to make the entire purchase feel straightforward, not just the payment step.


### **Frequently asked questions about Tabby payments**


1. **Can Indian businesses accept Tabby payments in India from UAE customers?**


Yes. Eligible Indian businesses on Razorpay Standard Checkout with International Payments enabled can activate Tabby from Dashboard → Account & Settings → International payments, subject to Razorpay’s and Tabby’s approval. Not available on Custom Checkout or server-to-server integrations.


2. **How can customers split payments with Tabby?**


Eligible customers can split a purchase into 4 payments, or pay over time for up to 12 months, as Tabby offers for that order. For example, an AED 2,100 purchase can be divided into 4 payments of AED 525 each, subject to Tabby’s approval and applicable terms.


3. **Do the businesses receive the full payment upfront?**


Razorpay automatically captures successful Tabby transactions. The business receives the captured amount, minus applicable MDR, through the settlement process. Tabby manages subsequent customer repayments.


4. **How long does Tabby settlement take?**


Razorpay settles Tabby payments to your registered Indian bank account in INR, 11 to 13 business days after the customer pays.


5. **Is Tabby available to customers in Saudi Arabia through Razorpay?**


Tabby is currently available to eligible UAE customers through this Razorpay integration. Support for Saudi Arabia is coming soon.


### **Make the checkout experience easier to complete**


An international customer may discover a product, appreciate its quality and be ready to buy. But if the checkout doesn’t offer a payment option that works for them, the sale can still fall through.


For Indian businesses looking to accept Tabby payments in India and sell to UAE customers, Tabby through Razorpay adds payment plans to that final step. Eligible customers get more flexibility, while businesses receive settlements through Razorpay without managing subsequent payments.


To switch Tabby on, go to Dashboard → Account & Settings → International payments and activate it, subject to approval. Read the technical documentation at


[https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/payment-methods/tabby](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/payment-methods/tabby) or contact your account manager.
